collaborator_agents.description: Parses raw telemetry, groups signals by host and parent PID, correlates MITRE techniques.
Inspects host process trees and checks canary honeypot file integrity using simulated EDR tools.
Performs reputation queries for external IPs, hashes, and ATT&CK techniques.
Evaluates blast radius, asset criticality, and suggests containment actions.
Executes policy-authorized containment actions (bounded or HITL gated) in simulated environment.
